cohort: 162 pregnant women presenting in labor at two government hospitals in Nigeria
finding: The incidence of pregnancy-related acute kidney injury (PRAKI) was 22.2%, with the main aetiologies being obstetric haemorrhage (66.7%), eclampsia (19.4%), and sepsis (13.9%).
mod_finding: Caesarean section was significantly associated with PRAKI (p=<0.001).
